hook.name: UnihoodStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches denominated in a tokenized stock quote currency. Charges a per-pool fixed swap fee (0–5%, set at launch, split 80/5/15 to creator/bid-wall/platform), manages a single-sided bid wall liquidity position below spot price funded by the wall fee share, and locks liquidity to only the factory and hook until the pool price reaches a graduation tick.
